notes: «جميعا عن أبي، معاوية»: the three co-transmitters meet at one name, written once, so one group with the three in one level
«- قال زهير حدثنا محمد بن خازم، -» is Muslim's remark that another version names a different transmitter: a variant group, not a route
«عن عباد بن حمزة، وعن فاطمة بنت المنذر، عن أسماء» is read as two co-transmitters of Hisham before Asma; the text does not say how Abbad's own route reaches Asma, so this is a best reading
Asma speaks the saying as the last link; the Prophet is the end
